company.description:
Medumo is a healthcare statrtup that helps healthcare organizations deliver the right instructions to the right patients at the right time using automated SMS and email.

The company combines technologies in mobile communication and artificial intelligence to equip providers with the capability to engage their patients more without more time or money. It also empowers patients by giving them the right information at precisely the time of need. Its ultimate vision is a more transparent, knowledgeable and healthy world.

productsAndServices.description: A software solution that automates patient communication, providing timely instructions and educational materials to patients through SMS and email.
